verified_against: thermal_foundation-1.20.1-11.0.6.70.jar (embeds thermal_core-1.20.1-11.0.6.24.jar), thermal_expansion-1.20.1-11.0.1.29.jar, thermal_dynamics-1.20.1-11.0.1.23.jar, thermal_innovation-1.20.1-11.0.1.23.jar, thermal_cultivation-1.20.1-11.0.1.24.jar

chain.title: A supply of tin
chain.desc: Mine raw tin and smelt it for gears and alloys. Use the installed recipe viewer to find the pack's ore distribution and any alternative tin sources.

chain.title: Gears for the workshop
chain.desc: Craft a tin gear for machine frames. Gears are shared components; plan your first machines around a steady energy supply and useful outputs.

chain.title: Build the machine frames
chain.desc: Craft a Machine Frame for Thermal Expansion machines. The frame opens several parallel routes: smelting, pulverizing, pressing, and other processing jobs.

chain.title: Power components
chain.desc: Make an RF Coil and keep a few spares. It is a basic ingredient for Thermal's machines and energy equipment.

chain.title: Solid fuel into energy
chain.desc: Connect a Stirling Dynamo to a compatible energy route and feed it an accepted fuel. Configure the coil side as the output and check the installed recipe's coolant requirements.

chain.title: A powered furnace
chain.desc: Supply a Redstone Furnace with energy and a smeltable input. Configure input and output sides before adding automatic item transfer.

chain.title: Crush and recover
chain.desc: Use the Pulverizer for ore processing, dusts, and useful byproducts. Read the installed recipe for yields and chances; raw ore is not always equivalent to an ore block.

chain.title: A small part with many uses
chain.desc: Craft a Redstone Servo for devices such as the Arboreal Extractor. This utility route can begin before a complete powered processing line.

chain.title: Harvest a living tree
chain.desc: Place an Arboreal Extractor against a suitable grown tree and collect its fluid output. Check the compatible trees and conditions before building a large grove.

chain.title: A rubber supply
chain.desc: Process latex into rubber using the installed recipe, then cure it. Keep fluid handling organized if this branch will supply a larger workshop.

chain.title: Alloy for tougher machines
chain.desc: Make invar from iron and nickel using an available alloy or blend recipe. A dust blend can bootstrap this material before you build an Induction Smelter.

chain.title: Alloys in one machine
chain.desc: Power an Induction Smelter for alloy and mixed-input recipes. Configure both ingredients and output handling so one accumulated byproduct cannot stop the line.

chain.title: Improve a machine's base performance
chain.desc: Install an Integral Component in compatible machines. Check the resulting energy demand as well as speed; an upgrade is only useful if the generator and transport can keep up.

chain.title: Buffer the factory
chain.desc: Add an Energy Cell and configure input and output faces. Keep a reserve for startup and short demand peaks rather than relying on generation to match every moment.

chain.title: Carry a charge
chain.desc: Charge a Flux Capacitor and configure which equipped items it may recharge. This equipment branch is independent of advanced alloy processing.

chain.title: A lava-powered alternative
chain.desc: Feed a Magmatic Dynamo with an accepted hot fluid. Choose a sustainable supply and compare its output with the machines you intend to run.

chain.title: Signals and stronger components
chain.desc: Produce signalum with the installed alloy recipe. Use it for advanced components after your basic power and materials loops are reliable.

chain.title: Raise the production ceiling
chain.desc: Upgrade the Integral Component tier in compatible machines. Recheck energy, input supply, and output capacity after changing machine speed.

chain.title: Choose a press mold
chain.desc: Power a Multiservo Press and install the mold required for the recipe. Plates, gears, and packing recipes use different configurations; one mold does not cover them all.

chain.title: Take powered tools underground
chain.desc: Craft and charge a Fluxbore from Thermal Innovation, then choose an appropriate mining mode. This optional tool requires the Innovation module to be installed.

chain.title: Heat-resistant construction material
chain.desc: Make hardened obsidian glass using the installed Induction Smelter recipe. It supports advanced Thermal components without making every utility device an endgame project.

chain.title: A luminous alloy
chain.desc: Produce lumium from its installed alloy recipe. Keep this materials branch alongside signalum; the two alloys solve different component requirements.

chain.title: An alloy for the top tier
chain.desc: Produce enderium using the required materials and machine recipe. Confirm the full recipe chain before spending scarce End resources.

chain.title: Finish the component ladder
chain.desc: Install the strongest verified Integral Component tier when the power grid can sustain it. Tune useful machines first instead of upgrading every idle machine.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: The thermal namespace spans Foundation, Expansion, and optional modules; missing-module items must be filtered by the pack scan.
This is the 1.20.1 integral-component system, not legacy upgrade kits.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
